Mohit Fernandes
Senior Business Development Manager | Remote (India)
mohit.fernandes367@example.com | +91 9566159838

Strategic B2B sales leader focused on technology and logistics accounts, driving revenue through targeted key account management and CRM-led processes. Strong negotiator who builds scalable sales workflows and partner relationships while maintaining accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene. Available with a 30 days notice period.

Experience

Cognizant — Nov 2020 - Present
Senior Business Development Manager (Remote)
- Led targeted B2B Sales pursuits in the APAC region, closing 8 enterprise deals worth $6.2M ARR by leveraging Salesforce-driven pipeline segmentation and opportunity scoring.
- Managed 12 strategic accounts using Key Account Management frameworks, increasing average deal size 38% year-over-year and reducing churn from 9% to 4%.
- Negotiation lead on multi-year contracts, achieving price improvements of 12% on average and securing 3 renewals with expanded scope valued at $2.1M.
- Implemented Salesforce customization and reporting standards, improving forecast accuracy from 62% to 87% and reducing sales cycle time by 22%.

Bluefin Logistics — Jan 2019 - Oct 2020
Account Executive (Remote)
- Drove B2B Sales for logistics solutions across manufacturing and retail verticals, generating $1.8M in new bookings through CRM-led outreach and qualification.
- Oversaw 20+ client relationships with a focus on Key Account Management, delivering tailored service bundles that improved client retention by 30%.
- Streamlined opportunity tracking in Salesforce and integrated CRM data with operations to shorten quote-to-cash by 18%.
- Negotiation owner for carrier and customer contracts, achieving cost savings of 9% while protecting margin and service levels.

Covalent Infotech — Apr 2014 - Dec 2018
Business Development Manager (Remote)
- Built and executed outbound B2B Sales campaigns targeting mid-market software buyers, closing 65 deals and contributing to a 4x pipeline growth over three years.
- Managed strategic accounts and client onboarding using CRM processes, increasing upsell conversion rate from 11% to 27%.
- Led contract Negotiation for service agreements and SLAs, standardizing terms that reduced legal review cycles by 40%.
- Coordinated cross-functional use of Jira for deal handoffs and project intake, reducing time-to-delivery for pilot engagements by 25%.

Projects
- CRM Migration and Adoption: Led a Salesforce migration project consolidating three legacy CRMs into a single instance; trained 60+ users and increased active CRM usage to 92% within 3 months.
- Account Expansion Playbook: Developed a repeatable Key Account Management playbook used across sales teams, resulting in a 15% lift in upsell velocity in pilot accounts.

Skills
- Sales: B2B Sales, Key Account Management, Negotiation
- Tools & CRM: Salesforce, CRM, Jira

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College

Notice Period: 30 days
